newsitem.title: GERMANY: German debt and futures up, await U.S. CPI data.
newsitem.headline: German debt and futures up, await U.S. CPI data.

text.p: German Bunds and futures rose in an active session on Thursday, underpinned by a U.S. debt market that shrugged off higher-than-expected producer price data that failed to spark inflation concerns.
DTB December Bund futures were up 18 basis points at 97.22 in late trade amid strong interest in the mid to the long-end of the German yield cruve.
"It looks as though the market wants to keep going higher," said one Frankfurt trader.
Dealings on Friday will focus on the release of U.S. consumer price data at 1230 GMT.
Traders said the producer price data was downplayed because surging energy prices fueled the rise while the core rate was lower and near market expectations.
"We will have to see the consumer price data to measure the impact but some are preparing for the chance that the inflation data will be bad news," a trader said.
A Reuter consensus survey expects a monthly increase of 0.2 to 0.3 percent. Bund futures are expected to trade between 97.00 and 97.30 ahead of the data.
On a technical basis, December Bund support is pegged at 97.00 and 96.89, resistance at 97.18 and 97.38.
